title: Six distinct NFkappaB signaling codons convey discrete information to distinguish stimuli and enable appropriate macrophage responses.
authors: Adelaja, Adewunmi; Taylor, Brooks; Sheu, Katherine M; Liu, Yi; Luecke, Stefanie; Hoffmann, Alexander
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NFkappaB信号动态编码刺激信息，聚焦细胞信号传导而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Macrophages initiate inflammatory responses via the transcription factor NFkappaB. The temporal pattern of NFkappaB activity determines which genes are expressed and thus, the type of response that ensues. Here, we examined how information about the stimulus is encoded in the dynamics of NFkappaB activity. We generated an mVenus-RelA reporter mouse line to enable high-throughput live-cell analysis of primary macrophages responding to host- and pathogen-derived stimuli. An information-theoretic workflow identified six dynamical features-termed signaling codons-that convey stimulus information to the nucleus. In particular, oscillatory trajectories were a hallmark of responses to cytokine but not pathogen-derived stimuli. Single-cell imaging and RNA sequencing of macrophages from a mouse model of Sjogren's syndrome revealed inappropriate responses to stimuli, suggestive of confusion of two NFkappaB signaling codons. Thus, the dynamics of NFkappaB signaling classify immune threats through six signaling codons, and signal confusion based on defective codon deployment may underlie the etiology of some inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 巨噬细胞通过转录因子NFkappaB启动炎症反应。NFkappaB活性的时间模式决定了哪些基因被表达，从而决定了随后发生的反应类型。在此，我们研究了刺激信息如何编码在NFkappaB活性的动态中。我们生成了mVenus-RelA报告基因小鼠品系，以实现对响应宿主和病原体来源刺激的原代巨噬细胞进行高通量活细胞分析。一种信息论工作流程识别出六个动态特征——称为信号密码子（signaling codons）——这些特征将刺激信息传递至细胞核。特别地，振荡轨迹是细胞因子而非病原体来源刺激响应的标志。来自干燥综合征（Sjogren's syndrome）小鼠模型的巨噬细胞单细胞成像和RNA测序揭示了对刺激的不适当响应，提示两种NFkappaB信号密码子的混淆。因此，NFkappaB信号动态通过六个信号密码子对免疫威胁进行分类，而基于密码子部署缺陷的信号混淆可能是某些炎症性疾病病因的基础。
